question: The third edition of the bilateral exercise ‘Samudra Shakti’ was held in which of the following countries in September 2021, where two Indian naval ships, Shivalik and Kadmatt, participated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **3rd edition** of the bilateral exercise **Samudra Shakti **took place in **September 2021** in Jaka
